description: Approve (approved=true) or reject (approved=false, note required) a collection or artifact at its current revision/version. New versions clear approvals.

approved.description: approved=false is a rejection and requires a note.

artifactId.description:
artifact_id approves/rejects a single artifact (from get_artifact); use
 instead of collection_id.

note.description: note explains the decision; required when approved=false (a rejection).

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: approve
title: Approve
